locations.title: Talk of the Teahouse
locations.description:
**Renown Level:** 15

**Patron:** Heartstruck Dowager

"Your merry band of outlaws and its dashing deeds of derring-do are all the talk amongst the ladies of the court. We have gathered together several items of worth, that you might continue on your gallantry."

**Crate Contents:**
- 400 Ability Points
- Valley Madder x 20
- Bloody Hide x 20
- Steelsilk x 20

locations.title: Respect
locations.description:
**Renown Level:** 45

**Patron:** The Bloodaxes

"Our order is one built on pride, but that does not mean we are too proud to give thanks where thanks is due. We may gave failed Martha once, but never again."

**Crate Contents:**
- Meteorite x 1

locations.title: Pillow Talk
locations.description:
**Renown Level:** 85

**Patron:** A Busy Courtesan

"Such is the renown of Cid the Outlaw, that much of my clientele would rather spend their time prattling on about _your_ endeavors than making any endeavors of their own. For that, I feel I owe you a least a portion of my earnings. A particularly enamored sort left this on my nightstand. May it serve you better than it did him."

**Crate Contents:**
- Berserker Ring  (Accessory)

locations.title: A Swelling Chorus
locations.description:
**Renown Level:** 135

**Patron:** Merry Mummer

"It used to be I would step into a tavern only to find myself overwhelmed with requests to sing of Dion the Bold or the Coerul and the Serving Girl. But now, all anyone wants to hear of is Cid the Outlaw. You have made me a very rich man, my friend."

**Crate Contents:**
- [A Rose is a Rose](#loc=286828) (Orchestrion Roll)
- Empty Shard x 1

locations.title: A Prayer for Safe Travels
locations.description:
**Renown Level:** 205

**Patron:** A Concerned Caravaneer

"They say it is your men who keep the roads free of beast and bandit. As one whose livelihood is reliant on safe passage from market to market, my chocobos and I thank you."

**Crate Contents:**
- Cleric's Medallion +1 (Accessory)

locations.title: Safe Passage
locations.description:
**Renown Level:** 295

**Patron:** Traveling Terpsichorean

"Not long ago, I was accosted by footpads as I walked the Gilded Path, and would have perished alone in the desert had not the Cursebreakers come to my aid. I owe them my life. May this token serve them well."

**Crate Contents:**
- Dire Wolf Jess (Accessory)

locations.title: A Token
locations.description:
**Renown Level:** 410

**Patron:** A Nameless Patron

"Many claim they wish to change the world. Few actually take it upon themselves to do so. You are an inspiration to use all."

**Crate Contents:**
- 800 Ability Points
- Briar Clam Shell x 25
- Desert Rose x 15

locations.title: The Bearer's Plight
locations.description:
**Renown Level:** 550

**Patron:** A Friend in Northreach

"Few are those who would strive to lighten the burden borne by the crystals' curse, but if we are to survive the coming storm, we must stand together—Bearer and Brother—as you have shown us."

**Crate Contents:**
- Meteorite x 2

locations.title: A Light from the Heavens
locations.description:
**Renown Level:** 715

**Patron:** A Humble Servant

"The goddess Greagor teaches us that to walk with the wretched is an act of greater good. If we are to accept this truth, then one could not rightly call he who follows this path an 'outlaw'."

**Crate Contents:**
- High Cleric's Medallion (Accessory)

locations.title: A Pall Lifted
locations.description:
**Renown Level:** 905

**Patron:** Dalimil Spicer

"Hugo's men are gone, and with them the fear in our hearts. Once more shall the markets echo with mirth and merriment. And it is you who we have to thank."

**Crate Contents:**
- 1500 Ability Points
- Sharp Fang x 40
- Bloody Hide x 30
- Steelsilk x 30

locations.title: Newfound Purpose
locations.description:
**Renown Level:** 1120

**Patron:** A Lonely Porter

"Since I can remember, I have served none but myself—turned my back on the world for a handful of silks and a heavy purse. But where has that left me? It is hard to keep joy in one's heart when all those around you are without. Something must change. And that change myst start with me."

**Crate Contents:**
- [No Risk, No Reward](#loc=286836) (Orchestrion Roll)
- Amber x 1

locations.title: A Gift
locations.description:
**Renown Level:** 1360

**Patron:** The Chapman

"Enclosed you will find an item of high and strange order—one for which I require neither thanks nor recompense. Consider it a reminder of where loyalties are best placed."

**Crate Contents:**
- Talisman of Priming (Accessory)

locations.title: A Fitting Performance
locations.description:
**Renown Level:** 1635

**Patron:** Viktor

"Natalie reports an unexpected surplus in Dalimil's stores, and, as means of showing the town's gratitude for past assistance, has expressed her distinct wish that one... 'Lord Underhill' partake in their good fortune."

**Crate Contents:**
- 2500 Ability Points
- Clutchmine x 20
- Wyrrite x 50
- Magicked Ash x 50

locations.title: Faith Undying
locations.description:
**Renown Level:** 1965

**Patron:** The Undying

"We are the shadows that wicked in the firebird's wake, and from the shadows do serve our lord and those who would His wings."

**Crate Contents:**
- Ring of the Swiftshot (Accessory)

locations.title: Continental Acclaim
locations.description:
**Renown Level:** 2365

**Patron:** Gerath

"If the drunken galley captain I shared a table with last night is to be believed, word of your exploits has made its way across the seas to the Great Continent. What is more, she claims there are those who would see you flourish—herself being one such woman."

**Crate Contents:**
- Genji Gloves (Accessory)

locations.title: Unsigned
locations.description:
**Renown Level:** 2850

**Patron:** Unsigned

"Every epic starts with a single word. Every symphony, a single note. This is but the beginning, and fore'er shall your legend be told. Fore'er shall your legacy be sung."

**Crate Contents:**
- [To Sail Forbidden Seas](#loc=286855) (Orchestrion Roll)
- Fallen Enigma x 1
